content: While jiant is quite flexible in the pipelines that can be specified through configs, and some components are highly modular (e.g., tasks, sentence encoders, and output heads), modification of the pipeline code can be difficult. For example, training in more than two phases would require modifying the trainer code. Making multi-stage training configurations more flexible is on jiant's development roadmap.
